title: Finite free coefficients and the specified direct-image scalar mate
statement: Let R and S be coefficient systems [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data] on schemes in universe u: each W has commutative ring sheaves R_W and S_W on its small pro-etale site, with specified inverse-image identifications for every scheme morphism. Let a be a Change, i.e. ring maps a_W:R_W→S_W commuting with those identifications. Let g:U→V be any scheme morphism and d a natural number. Suppose the S_V-module S_V, restricted along a_V, is isomorphic as an R_V-module sheaf to the product of d copies of R_V. For every unbounded derived R_U-module M, the specified scalar-adjunction mate properComparison(a,g) of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison] is invertible at M. Its source is extension along a_V of Rg_{*,R} M and its target is Rg_{*,S} of extension along a_U of M. No properness, Noetherian, dimension, completeness, constructibility, or finite-Tor condition is imposed.

source.place: Tags 0B56, equation-projection-formula-map, and 07A6, lemma-adjoint; finite free case of lemma-projection-formula. The normalized existing direct-image comparison is lem-sp-finite-free-direct-image-coherence.

proof.text: Identify the given finite product with the finite coproduct, then reindex by ULift(Fin d). Instantiate the coefficient-square records of [lem-sp-finite-free-direct-image-coherence] using R.pull g, S.pull g and a.square g. The theorem supplies normalized scalar models and invertibility of their specified direct-image comparison. Its finite-basis column proof includes d=0 and all unbounded inputs.

Apply Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv to the balancing square defining that comparison. By definition balancing is the inverse conjugate of the published restriction/direct-image isomorphism. The iterated mate is therefore exactly its inverse. Invertibility has now been proved for the inverse scalar mate in the normalized models.

Conjugate the identity transformations of the two exact scalar restriction functors to obtain isomorphisms from the normalized left adjoints to pbcDerivedExtend. The mate/conjugate vertical-composition identities show that the two inverse scalar mates differ only by whiskering with these isomorphisms. At each input one side is a composite of isomorphisms; cancel the other isomorphism to prove invertibility of properComparison. This is the private categorical helper inverseMate_isIso_of_isIso, fully proved in the module.

proof_origin.place: Specialization of the existing finite-free direct-image coherence theorem to PurCompactSupport.properComparison; normalization is proved by iterated mates and identity conjugates.

lean.statement:
theorem properComparison_isIso_of_finiteFree {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V) (d : ℕ)
    (hfree : Nonempty
      ((pbcRestrict (a.map V)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget V).obj (S.ring V))) ≅
        ∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin d ↦ SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget V).obj (R.ring V))))
    (M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules U (R.ring U))) :
    IsIso ((properComparison a g).app M)
